svg.font-family: 'STIX Two Text','STIX Two Math','Times New Roman',serif
svg.title: Selected MAP parameterizations and fitted reference ranges
svg.desc: Computed parameter summaries in four groups. For each of the 26 parameters, markers show the selected MAP of each of the eight geometries, each geometry with its own marker symbol and color; the box, median line and whiskers summarize 256 ideal-target draws from the fitted (5,3,1) reference density. All coordinates are positions within the prior range in percent. FGF4-LUMEN, the initial cavity-associated FGF4 loading, is outlined.
svg.text: Selected MAP parameterizations and fitted reference ranges
Selected MAPs across eight geometries and marginal summaries of the fitted (5,3,1) reference density.
Initial FGF4-LUMEN is highlighted as a model parameter.
